Arab College for Applied Sciences

📍 Gaza City, Gaza
College Gaza Operational

The Arab College for Applied Sciences is a smaller private higher education institution in Gaza City offering programmes in business administration, accounting, and information technology. It served students seeking practical, career-oriented qualifications in the Gaza business sector.
